items.title: Carazinho (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #4
items.en_title: Carazinho (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #4
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Carazinho (RS) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 132,000; proposals close Nov 20 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
